items.title: Le pivot géopolitique de l’accélération de Xi se trouve au Guangxi
items.description: Connaissez-vous trois provinces chinoises ? Pour comprendre la Chine de Xi, il faut sortir de Pékin et de Shanghai. Notre nouvelle série part à la rencontre des espaces où se construit une autre figure du futur. Pour recevoir cette série qui nous a déjà amené du Sichuan au Zhejiang , abonnez-vous au Grand Continent . Dans votre boîte mail à partir de 8 euros par mois La région autonome Zhuang du Guangxi est un territoire situé aux confins de la Chine. Cette marginalité est directement exprimée dans les idéogrammes utilisés pour écrire le nom de la région, le Guangxi (广西) désignant littéralement « l’expansion vers l’Ouest ». Elle est bordée au nord-ouest par les plateaux du Yunnan et du Guizhou, et au sud par sa frontière avec le Vietnam et le golfe du Tonkin, lui offrant ainsi un débouché sur la mer de Chine méridionale. Cette baie naturellement semi-fermée constitue historiquement un havre prisé des navigateurs, notamment pendant les périodes de mousson qui frappent chaque année. Région montagneuse dont les nombreuses rivières ont formé les paysages karstiques spectaculaires de la ville Guilin, elle est l’une des plus visitées en Chine. Le Guangxi est l’une des cinq régions autonomes, avec la Mongolie-Intérieure, le Ningxia, le Tibet et le Xinjiang. Elle abrite notamment 14 millions de Zhuang, la minorité ethnique la plus nombreuse parmi les 56 officiellement reconnus par la République populaire. La région dispose de nombreux gisements de minerais et constitue à ce titre l’une des principales bases de production de métaux non ferreux du pays « Commissaire Wang Jianyi : Promouvoir le développement de haute qualité des métaux non ferreux et des industries métalliques clés dans le Guangxi » , Conférence consultative politique populaire , 26 février 2026.'> 1 . Elle est particulièrement connue pour ses réserves abondantes de manganèse et d’étain, les plus abondantes de Chine « Aperçu des ressources minérales dans le Guangxi » , Géologie chinoise , vol. 3, 1987.'> 2 . Forte de ce capital naturel, le Guangxi est un pôle de production de produits métallurgiques et dérivés, dont une part importante se trouve à Liuzhou, la capitale économique historique. La fusion et la pression des métaux ferreux et non ferreux constituaient ainsi le principal secteur économique en termes de revenus en 2022 (26 % « Guangxi Market Profile » , HKTDC Research , 17 septembre 2026.'> 3 ). Depuis les années 2000, la ville est devenue un hub de production automobile (9 % 4 ), notamment autour de la coentreprise fondée par l’Américain General Motors avec le groupe d’État SAIC Motor Corp., Ltd. Le climat subtropical de la région favorise l’épanouissement d’une végétation dense et de nombreuses espèces de fruits tropicaux et subtropicaux. Ainsi, 80 % des espèces et variétés de ces fruits qui se trouvent sur l’ensemble du territoire chinois, sont présentes au Guangxi Regional China : a business and economic handbook, Palgrave Macmillan, 2013.'> 5 . Il s’agit de l’une des principales provinces pour la production agricole, notamment de canne à sucre « Guangxi Market Profile » , HKTDC Research , 17 septembre 2026.'> 6 . La région autonome possède également un fort potentiel dans la production d’électricité décarbonée. C’est particulièrement le cas pour l’hydroélectricité, le Guangxi accueillant depuis 2009 le barrage de Longtan (龙滩大坝), l’un des plus grands au monde. Malgré ses dotations naturelles et sa situation géographique favorable aux échanges, la région est restée jusqu’au début des années 2000 relativement à la marge du développement national. La position géostratégique du Guangxi pendant la guerre froide a fait de celle-ci, à l'instar du Yunnan, une question de sécurité nationale, limitant considérablement le commerce avec les pays voisins. Le Guangxi a servi de base arrière à l'armée chinoise lors de son soutien au Vietnam pendant les guerres contre la France et les États-Unis, mais aussi lors de son offensive contre son voisin du Sud en 1979, en réponse à l'occupation du Cambodge par ce dernier. En raison des tensions persistantes entre la Chine et le Vietnam, la prédominance des questions de sécurité a continué à entraver le commerce après le lancement de la politique de « réforme et d'ouverture » (改革开放). C'est l’une des raisons pour lesquelles la ville portuaire de Beihai, bien que figurant parmi les 14 villes portuaires ouvertes aux investissements étrangers en 1984, n'a pas connu le développement économique de villes comme Tianjin, Shanghai ou Guangzhou Asian Perspective , vol. 43, n°2, 2019, p. 273-295.'> 7 . Ce n’est que dans les années 1990, avec la fin de la guerre froide et la normalisation des relations avec les pays d’Asie du Sud-Est que le Guangxi a connu un début d’essor économique, notamment grâce aux échanges commerciaux avec ses voisins. Ceux-ci sont portés par l’Accord de libre-échange entre la Chine et l’ASEAN (ACFTA, ASEAN–China Free Trade Area) signé en 2004 et dont la mise en œuvre est pleinement achevée en 2010. À partir de 2005, la région autonome renforce également sa connectivité avec la péninsule Sud-Est asiatique en devenant membre officiel du cadre de coopération de la sous-région du Grand Mékong 8 , un programme de développement transnational lancé par la Banque asiatique de développement (BAD). Celui-ci a pour objectif, via le financement d’infrastructures le long de corridors économiques 9 , de reconstituer les anciennes routes commerciales, tombées en désuétude pendant la Guerre froide. Devenir l’interface des échanges entre la Chine et l’Asie du Sud-Est : la fabrique d’un corridor multimodal C’est dans ce nouveau contexte que les autorités du Guangxi déploient une stratégie de développement visant à faire de la région autonome la principale interface d’échange entre la Chine et l’Asie du Sud-Est. Elles font ainsi la promotion depuis 2006 d’une zone de coopération économique autour du golfe du Tonkin, incluant la mer de Chine méridionale, le Vietnam, la Malaisie, Singapour et l’Indonésie The Deer and the Dragon : Southeast Asia and China in the 21 st Century, Singapore, ISEAS-Yusof Ishak Institute, 2020.'> 10 . Celle-ci a été renforcée en 2010 par le corridor économique entre Nanning et Singapour, une excroissance de ceux promus par la BAD. À travers ces initiatives, les autorités provinciales explorent diverses formes de coopération commerciale et maritime avec les pays de l’ASEAN, telles que la coopération portuaire, le tourisme maritime et l’exploitation conjointe des ressources énergétiques Asian Perspective , vol. 43, n°2, 2019, p. 273-295.'> 11 . Les autorités locales ont obtenu dès le départ le soutien du gouvernement central « Chinese Provinces as Semi-Autonomous Diplomatic Actors in China’s Investments in Southeast Asia. Evidence from Guangxi Institutions and Individuals in the Mining Sector » , Moussons. Recherche En Sciences Humaines Sur l’Asie Du Sud-Est , vol. 41, juin 2023.'> 12 , dont l’action s’inscrit alors dans le cadre de la politique nationale de développement de l’Ouest chinois (西部大开发), une priorité sous les mandats de Jiang Zemin (1993-2002) puis de Hu Jintao (2002-2012) afin de réduire les écarts de richesse entre provinces côtières et intérieures. Le Guangxi se voit octroyer une plus grande autonomie dans la gestion de son commerce extérieur, ainsi que des fonds pour le financement des infrastructures. Ces fonds sont notamment issus du China-ASEAN Investment Cooperation Fund mis en place en 2010 pour soutenir les initiatives de connectivités dans la région China-ASEAN Investment Cooperation Fund '> 13 . Cet adoubement par Pékin ne s’est pas seulement matérialisé par un soutien financier, la région autonome ayant également acquis un quasi-monopole sur l’organisation des grandes messes annuelles consacrées à la coopération entre la Chine et l’ASEAN. Il en va ainsi de la China-ASEAN Expo (中国-东盟博览会) initiée en 2004 et qui se réunit tous les ans à Nanning China-ASEAN EXPO '> 14 . Ce dispositif se décline par ailleurs en une multitude de forums spécialisés, comme le China-ASEAN Mining Cooperation Forum (中国—东盟矿业合作论坛). En reprenant les initiatives préexistantes, tout en y accordant des moyens considérables, les Nouvelles routes de la soie (BRI) lancées par Xi Jinping en 2013 ont accéléré la mise en œuvre de l’agenda de connectivité régionale. Celui-ci a été renforcé par le nouveau corridor commercial international terre-mer (国际陆海贸易新通道) en 2015, un projet visant à relier la ville de Chongqing à Singapour par la terre à travers un réseau de voies ferrées, mais également par la mer, via un cadre de coopération entre les principaux ports de la mer de Chine méridionale. Cette stratégie nationale vise à faire de la région autonome un nœud commercial entre les provinces occidentales chinoises et les pays d’Asie du Sud-Est, rassemblée derrière le mot d’ordre « une zone, deux sites, un parc, un corridor » (一区两地一园一通道). Elle a pour objectif de réorienter les flux commerciaux et logistiques en proposant un itinéraire à même de réduire le temps de transport de près d'une semaine par rapport aux itinéraires conventionnels passant par les ports du Guangdong et du Fujian. Cette stratégie nationale de développement conforte la position stratégique du Guangxi comme point névralgique d’un corridor multimodal articulant infrastructures maritimes, ferroviaires et fluviales. Pour augmenter les capacités de transit des marchandises par le littoral, des dizaines de milliards de dollars ont été investis dans la modernisation et l’extension des infrastructures portuaires « Beibu Gulf Port keeps eye on 2025 intl gateway transformation plan » , Regional China Daily , 7 décembre 2021.'> 15 . Fangchenggang (防城港), Qinzhou (钦州) et Beihai (北海) sont désormais reliés à plus de 200 ports dans plus de 100 pays et régions du monde et couvrent la quasi-totalité des ports maritimes des pays membres de l'ASEAN « GLOBALink | Économie orientée océanique dans le Guangxi : Port du Golfe de Beibu » , Xinhuanet , 30 mai 2024.'> 16 . Ils sont opérés par le Guangxi Beibu Gulf International Port Group Company Limited (广西北部湾国际港务集团有限公司), une entreprise d’État placée sous l’autorité du gouvernement de la région autonome. Le groupe investit également dans le développement d’infrastructures portuaires et de zones industrielles dans plusieurs pays d’Asie du Sud-Est, notamment à Kuantan en Malaisie et à Muara au Brunei « Malaysia–China Kuantan Industrial Park (MCKIP) », The People’s Map , 16 avril 2025.'> 17 . Pour bénéficier de transferts de compétences, mais également renforcer ses liaisons maritimes, le port central de Qinzhou bénéficie de la coopération de l’entreprise d’État COSCO Shipping ainsi que de l’entreprise d’État singapourienne PSA International. Pour le déploiement du premier terminal à conteneur automatisé combinant voie maritime et ferroviaire en Chine à Qinzhou « Qinzhou Port area becomes pioneer in sea-rail integration » , Site de Guangxi , 22 mai 2024.'> 18 , le groupe portuaire a également bénéficié de l’implication de Shanghai Zhenhua Heavy Industries (上海振华重工) « La construction de la deuxième phase du terminal à conteneurs automatisé de Qinzhou bat son plein » , China Internet Information Center , 3 novembre 2022.'> 19 , une des filiales de la China Communications Construction Company (中国交通建设), l’une des principales entreprises d’État impliquées dans la construction des infrastructures de la BRI. Ces avancées technologiques permettent notamment d’assurer la connexion avec les deux lignes ferroviaires reliant la frontière sino-vietnamienne en complément des 10 autoroutes construites pour mener aux postes-frontières « China’s Guangxi advances “three connectivity” with Vietnam », Vietnam plus, 11 avril 2026.'> 20 . Des dispositifs de zones économiques spéciales (ZES) 21 ont également été déployés le long de la frontière avec le Vietnam pour faciliter les échanges. On retrouve par exemple à Pingxiang (凭祥) et à Dongxing (东兴), les deux principaux points de passages, des zones frontalières de coopération économique (边境经济合作区) pour renforcer les échanges avec les pays voisins. Ces deux villes sont également devenues des points importants d’expérimentation du développement et de l’ouverture (重点开发开放试验区). Celle de Dongxing a ainsi mis en place de nombreuses innovations institutionnelles, comme la première plateforme de service monétaire avec l’ASEAN et le premier centre national d’échange entre le Renminbi (RMB) et le Dong, la monnaie vietnamienne. En 2014, elle a également déployé le premier centre d’assurance transnational et le premier port transfrontalier d’échange de céréales China's Special Economic Zones(中国的特殊经济空间), Science Press, 2022.'> 22 . L’enjeu ne se limite donc pas à la facilitation des échanges, mais comprend la construction d’un espace industriel transfrontalier où la logistique et les activités manufacturières sont intégrées dans une chaîne de production régionale unique « Beibu Gulf Port retains double-digit growth » , The State Council – The People’s Republic of China, 4 janvier 2025 ; « La ville de Haiphong, au Vietnam et le Guangxi, en Chine, renforcent la coopération dans le domaine des ports maritimes » , Bureau économique et commercial de l’ambassade de la République populaire de Chine en République socialiste du Vietnam, 25 février 2025.'> 23 . Le Guangxi cherche ainsi à se positionner comme un intermédiaire incontournable du débordement des chaînes d’approvisionnement (供应链的 ‘溢出’) The overflow : The future history of made in China (溢出：中国制造未来史) , Beijing, CITIC, 2020.'> 24 du sud de la Chine sur le nord du Vietnam, un mouvement qui s’est accéléré depuis le déclenchement de la guerre commerciale par la première administration Trump en 2018. L’intégration régionale comme moteur de la transformation industrielle locale Les autorités locales capitalisent sur le renforcement de la connectivité avec l’ASEAN pour développer la région autonome. Les nouvelles infrastructures doivent permettre d’attirer davantage d’investissements et de faire évoluer l’industrie locale vers des activités à plus haute valeur ajoutée. L’objectif est de faire du Guangxi la porte d’entrée des ressources naturelles en provenance d’Asie du Sud-Est, avant que celles-ci ne soient transformées et vendues en Chine ou réexportées dans la région. Cette stratégie se retrouve dans les chiffres du commerce extérieur de la région autonome, dont les importations, hors produits mécaniques et électroniques, sont largement dominées par les ressources naturelles. La grande majorité des exportations concerne quant à elle des biens manufacturés intermédiaires tels que l'électronique et l'électroménager, les pièces automobiles, les engins de chantier, les textiles et les batteries au lithium vers l'ASEAN High-quality development, I say, expanding the new space for ASEAN trade, how can Guangxi exert its efforts ? », Guangxi Daily , 16 juillet 2025.'> 25 . Dans les secteurs traditionnels tels que l’agroalimentaire ou la métallurgie, l’ambition de la province est d’investir les activités de transformation et de réserver les activités énergivores et à plus faible valeur aux pays de la région. Le parc industriel Chine-Malaisie de Qinzhou (中马钦州产业园区), un projet emblématique de la coopération industrielle transfrontalière, illustre ce phénomène. Il doit permettre la transformation locale de produits stratégiques tels que le soja et l’huile de palme importés de Malaisie et d’Indonésie, avant leur redistribution sur le marché chinois sous forme de produits semi-finis ou finis. Dans le domaine du traitement des minerais, la province du Guangxi encourage et facilite également les investissements dans les infrastructures destinées à transformer les matières premières domestiques et importées avant d’exporter des produits semi-finis ou finis, à l’image des fonderies de fer et de manganèse qui se développent notamment dans le cadre de la coopération minière avec les pays de l’ASEAN « Chinese Provinces as Semi-Autonomous Diplomatic Actors in China’s Investments in Southeast Asia. Evidence from Guangxi Institutions and Individuals in the Mining Sector » , Moussons. Recherche En Sciences Humaines Sur l’Asie Du Sud-Est , vol. 41, juin 2023.'> 26 . Pour diversifier son économie, le Guangxi a investi massivement dans les infrastructures destinées à renforcer l’intégration numérique avec l’ASEAN China’s Belt and Road Initiative : The Impact on Sub-Regional Southeast Asia , London, Routledge, 2021 ; Nowmay Opalinski, « Données à l’Est, calcul à l’Ouest : l’infrastructure numérique de l’IA comme enjeu territorial en Chine », Hérodote , vol. 200-201, n°1, 2026, p. 225-243.'> 27 . Dans le cadre du modèle « R&D à Pékin, Shanghai et Guangzhou + intégration au Guangxi + application au sein de l’ASEAN » (北上广研发+广西集成+东盟应用) The 21st Guitai Economic, Trade and Cultural Cooperation Forum Focuses on New Opportunities for Cross-Strait Artificial Intelligence Cooperation », Xinhua News , 11 novembre 2025.'> 28 , le Guangxi localise, teste et exporte les technologies chinoises, notamment au Laos, en Malaisie et en Indonésie, par l’intermédiaire du Centre Chine-ASEAN pour la coopération en matière d’application et d’innovation dans le domaine de l’intelligence artificielle (IA). Pour servir de porte d’entrée vers l’ASEAN dans le domaine numérique, le Guangxi a dû investir dans la formation des développeurs, l’entraînement des grands modèles linguistiques (LLM), la création de plateformes d’IA et des capacités de calcul. En reliant les capacités numériques locales à la demande de l’ASEAN, le Guangxi cherche à construire un marché régional pour les produits chinois d’IA China, ASEAN strengthen connectivity in industrial AI application », Vietnamplus , 5 juin 2026.'> 29 . À l’image des autres provinces chinoises, le Guangxi a aussi cherché ces dernières années à faire évoluer son industrie automobile vers la production de véhicules électriques (VE). Ainsi le cluster de Liuzhou (柳州), formé autour de la coentreprise GM-SAIC, s’est enrichi de la coopération avec l’entreprise Wuling pour produire des VE, dont des mini-voiturettes qui se sont vendues à plus de 1,2 million d’unités en Chine en 2024 Wuling Hongguang MINI EV Tops China’s Pure Electric Market with Over 1.8 Million Units Sold », Wulingcars .'> 30 . Là encore, les autorités locales cherchent à faire de la coopération avec l’ASEAN le moteur du développement du secteur. La base de production de véhicules électriques à énergies nouvelles Chine-ASEAN de Guigang (贵港), visant la création d’une chaîne de valeur complète entre la région autonome et ses voisins, accueillait ainsi 40 entreprises opérationnelles du secteur en 2019 Green cars driving economic boom in Guangxi’s Guigang », China services info , 23 mai 2019.'> 31 . Des limites persistantes Malgré l’amélioration significative de ses infrastructures et le soutien dont elle bénéficie de la part du gouvernement central, la région peine à mettre en œuvre sa stratégie de transformation industrielle. De nombreux projets d’investissements d’infrastructures et d’entreprises se révèlent non viables économiquement. Comme dans d'autres provinces chinoises, les autorités locales ont par exemple été blâmées publiquement pour avoir mis en place des incitations excessives afin d’attirer des projets d’investissement. Nanning a ainsi injecté 2,4 milliards de RMB dans Hozon New Energy, la société mère des véhicules électriques Nezha CCTV takes aim at local governments’ race-to-the-bottom investment attraction practices », Trivium China , 22 avril 202'> 32 . L’entreprise a accumulé 18,3 milliards de RMB de pertes entre 2021 et 2023, avant de cesser son activité en 2024 et que les créanciers demandent en 2025 le redressement judiciaire de l’entreprise. Le Guangxi peine également à attirer des investisseurs étrangers, qui sont de moins en moins nombreux Guangxi : Market Profile », HKTDC Research , 17 septembre 2026.'> 33 . En cause : notamment un environnement juridique et des ressources humaines locales moins attractives que dans les provinces côtières exportatrices, qui multiplient également les initiatives de coopération avec les pays de l’ASEAN. Pour pallier ces faiblesses structurelles, des accords de coopération ont été signés avec les gouvernements de Hong Kong et de Singapour, notamment dans les services juridiques et dans la formation des cadres locaux. Situé aux confins de la Chine, le développement du Guangxi a été entravé jusqu'à la fin du XX e siècle par la guerre froide. Depuis le réchauffement des relations avec les pays de l'ASEAN, la région autonome cherche à capitaliser sur son industrie de transformation des ressources naturelles pour devenir un hub d'échange entre la région et les provinces occidentales de la Chine. Pour cela, elle construit, avec l'appui politique et financier du gouvernement central, un ensemble d'infrastructures et d'institutions de coopération à même de renforcer les échanges avec les pays voisins, au point d’acquérir une centralité institutionnelle sans équivalent parmi les provinces chinoises dans l'organisation de la diplomatie économique avec l'ASEAN. Entre la fin du XX e siècle et aujourd’hui, le Guangxi a donc acquis une centralité institutionnelle sans équivalent parmi les provinces chinoises dans l'organisation de la diplomatie économique avec l'ASEAN. Cette réussite institutionnelle et infrastructurelle ne s'est toutefois pas encore traduite en un développement industriel à la hauteur des ambitions affichées et le Guangxi peine à transformer sa position géostratégique en avantage économique durable. Ce cas illustre ainsi les limites d'une stratégie de développement régional reposant avant tout sur le volontarisme infrastructurel et le soutien de l'échelon central : la construction de corridors et d'institutions de coopération ne suffit pas, à elle seule, à produire la montée en gamme industrielle recherchée par les autorités locales. L’aboutissement des ambitions de la province reste à ce jour suspendu à plusieurs inconnues : l'achèvement et la rentabilité du canal de Pinglu, la capacité du Guangxi à tenir son pari sur l'intelligence artificielle et les véhicules électriques face à des concurrents provinciaux mieux positionnés, et enfin la persistance de frictions géopolitiques, qui rappellent que l'intégration économique régionale ne dissout pas entièrement les tensions héritées. items.title: Lagos Task Force detains dismissed operative over alleged extortion
items.description: The Lagos State Environmental and Special Offences Enforcement Unit (Task Force) has detained a dismissed operative for alleged impersonation and extortion of motorists and traders. The chairman of task force, CSP Adetayo Akerele, disclosed this in a statement signed by the agency’s spokesperson, Mr Abdulraheem Gbadeyan on Sunday in Lagos. Akerele said that the suspect was detained at Oshodi bus-stop following the circulation of a viral video of his apprehension. The chairman said that the suspect, a former paramilitary operative, was dismissed several months ago over alleged misconduct, including theft, use of a fake identity card, extortion of motorists and traders, and indiscipline. “The suspect continued to pose as a serving task force official after his dismissal. “Operatives accosted the suspect for questioning, but he allegedly rejected the invitation and resisted arrest before being apprehended through tactical coordination and minimal force. “The suspect no longer had any affiliation with the agency, ” he said. The task force boss said the alleged impersonation could mislead the public and undermine confidence in legitimate law enforcement activities. “The arrest underscored the agency’s determination to prevent dismissed personnel and other unauthorised individuals from exploiting its identity and authority for unlawful purposes, ” he said. According to him, the suspect will be arraigned in court on Monday, after completion of investiation. He urged residents to verify the identities of individuals claiming to be task force officials and report suspicious activities through appropriate channels. Akerele also urged journalists to verify allegations and obtain responses from relevant parties before publication to promote balanced and responsible reporting. He reaffirmed the agency’s commitment to protecting residents and preventing the abuse of its name and authority. The post Lagos Task Force detains dismissed operative over alleged extortion appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: NPP holds national thanksgiving service in Goaso after successful internal elections
items.description: The New Patriotic Party (NPP) has held a national thanksgiving service at the Seventh-day Adventist (SDA) Church in Goaso in the Ahafo Region to express gratitude to God following what it described as successful elections of its executives and flagbearer. The service formed part of the party’s efforts to seek divine guidance, protection and wisdom as it prepares for the 2028 general elections. Addressing the congregation, NPP General Secretary Justin Frimpong Kodua said the party considered it important to hold a thanksgiving service with members of the SDA Church, who observe their day of worship on Saturdays, to thank God for the peaceful conduct of its internal elections. Read also: Here are NPP’s newly elected executives He said the party was also seeking God’s direction and protection as it works towards its goal of winning the 2028 general elections. Meanwhile, the party’s National Chairman, John Boadu, said NPP flagbearer Dr Mahamudu Bawumia would address concerns among SDA members relating to elections held on Saturdays if elected president in 2028. According to him, Dr Bawumia would speak on the matter at the appropriate time and explain the steps he intends to take. The Presiding Superintendent and President of the SDA Church, Jonathan Owusu, urged the NPP to prioritise unity and teamwork as it prepares for the next general elections. He commended the party for organising the thanksgiving service following its internal elections, describing the gesture as a positive sign of unity, and encouraged its members to work together towards their electoral goal.

items.title: 2027: Defeating Tinubu in 12 states is wishful thinking – Lagos APC tells Makinde
items.description: By Olasunkanmi Akoni The Lagos State chapter of the All Progressives Congress (APC) has dismissed the claim by Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde’s campaign organisation that it will defeat President Bola Tinubu in 12 states in the 2027 presidential election. APC described the declaration as grandiose, wishful thinking and political bravado without electoral evidence. Lagos APC Spokesman, Seye Oladejo, reacting to the claim said participation in an election is not a guarantee of victory. According to him, “Governor Makinde and his campaign team appear to have mistaken the privilege of participating in an election for the guarantee of victory. In the Olympics, participation is celebrated, but no athlete earns a gold medal merely for showing up at the starting line,” the Lagos APC said. The party said the 2027 presidential election is not a theatrical performance rewarded for loudest declarations, noting that it demands national reach, organisational depth, credible structures and capacity to mobilise voters across the federation. “On these fundamental indices, Makinde’s boast raises more questions about the foundations of his confidence than it offers evidence of his electoral strength. Where is the demonstrable national structure? What coalition of enduring value has he assembled?” APC queried. It said Makinde should be more concerned about political crises within his own political family in Oyo State and his unravelling relationships with erstwhile allies, rather than projecting national invincibility. “A politician who has yet to convincingly demonstrate enduring cohesion within his immediate political environment should be cautious about presenting himself as the architect of a nationwide electoral upset,” it said. The party said President Tinubu brings decades of political experience, formidable national network and proven capacity for coalition-building to the 2027 contest, attributes which cannot be wished away by announcing a dozen states. It added that Nigerians will judge platforms on ideas, records and vision, stressing that opposition must do more than announce states it intends to win. “Makinde’s declaration sounds less like a carefully reasoned electoral forecast and more like an attempt to manufacture momentum through headline-grabbing bravado. It is political confidence without sufficiently demonstrated evidence,” the party said. The Lagos APC advised Makinde to spend less time counting imaginary victories and more time examining political turbulence around him, noting that ballot presence does not equal mandate. “After all, in the ultimate reckoning of democracy, the electorate awards the medals, not campaign organisations intoxicated by their own declarations,” Oladejo said. items.title: PLF 2027 : le gouvernement prévoit une réforme structurelle des marchés et des prix
items.description: Le soutien au pouvoir d’achat figure en tête des cinq priorités du projet de loi de finances 2027, présenté lors du Conseil des ministres présidé samedi par le Roi Mohammed VI. Le gouvernement prévoit notamment une réforme structurelle des marchés et des prix à partir de 2027, une augmentation des aides sociales directes et la poursuite de la généralisation de la couverture sanitaire. Le soutien au pouvoir d’achat des citoyens constituera la première priorité du projet de loi de finances 2027. Réuni samedi 17 octobre au palais royal de Rabat sous la présidence du Roi Mohammed VI, le Conseil des ministres a examiné et approuvé les orientations générales du texte, qui prévoit plusieurs mesures en faveur des ménages et du renforcement de l’État social. Selon le communiqué du Cabinet royal, le gouvernement prévoit d’engager, dès 2027, une réforme structurelle des marchés et des prix. Cette démarche doit s’accompagner de mesures destinées à soutenir le pouvoir d’achat des citoyens, dont les détails devraient être dévoilés ultérieurement La première priorité du projet de loi de finances porte également sur l’augmentation du montant des aides sociales directes. Le gouvernement entend ainsi poursuivre les mesures de soutien aux ménages dans le cadre du renforcement des fondements d’un État social durable. Couverture sanitaire et services publics La poursuite de la généralisation de la couverture sanitaire figure parmi les autres mesures annoncées. Le gouvernement prévoit également de garantir la pérennité de ses régimes, avec des dispositions techniques et financières envisagées à cet effet. Le renforcement des systèmes publics de santé et d’éducation constitue un autre volet de cette priorité. Le texte annonce un effort accru pour améliorer ces deux secteurs, dans le cadre de la consolidation de l’État social. L’accès au logement décent figure également parmi les objectifs retenus. Le gouvernement prévoit de poursuivre la mise en œuvre du programme d’aide directe au logement afin de renforcer l’accès des citoyens à un habitat répondant à leurs besoins. Un contexte économique international incertain Les orientations du projet de loi de finances 2027 ont été présentées dans un contexte international marqué, selon le ministre de l’Économie et des Finances et de l’Efficacité publique, par l’augmentation du coût des conflits géostratégiques, l’élargissement des tendances protectionnistes et l’intensification de la concurrence autour de l’énergie, des technologies et du financement. Dans ce contexte, les prévisions présentées lors du Conseil des ministres tablent sur une croissance de l’économie nationale de 4,7 % à la fin de 2026, une inflation contenue autour de 0,7 % et un déficit budgétaire ramené à 3 % du produit intérieur brut. Le soutien au pouvoir d’achat constitue ainsi le premier axe du projet de loi de finances pour l’année prochaine. Les modalités concrètes de la réforme des marchés et des prix, le montant de la revalorisation des aides sociales directes et les moyens consacrés au renforcement des services publics devront être précisés dans les mesures de mise en œuvre du budget 2027. items.title: 2027: We’ll repay good deeds with votes, Jigawa APC chairman says
items.description: By Muhammad Inuwa, Dutse The All Progressives Congress (APC) Chairman in Ringim Local Government Area of Jigawa State, Bashir Danmalam, has pledged to mobilise massive votes for President Bola Tinubu, Governor Umar Namadi and other party candidates in the 2027 general elections. Danmalam made the pledge on Saturday during an APC stakeholders’ meeting in Ringim, saying residents would reciprocate what he described as the benefits of the APC-led administrations by voting overwhelmingly for the party. He said the developmental projects and political opportunities provided by the administrations had given the people of the area reasons to support the party in the forthcoming elections. “We don’t have enough words to express our gratitude to Governor Umar Namadi and President Bola Ahmed Tinubu for what they have done for us. The best way to appreciate them is to vote for the APC again in 2027,” he said. Danmalam said the Namadi administration had addressed several challenges that had affected the local government for decades, particularly unreliable electricity supply. He said connecting Ringim to the Gagarawa electricity grid had brought relief to residents who had endured unstable power supply for more than 30 years. “This administration has solved many serious challenges facing our people for several years, including connecting Ringim to the Gagarawa grid for steady electricity supply, solarising water schemes to improve water availability and providing access to quality education,” he said. The APC chairman also commended the governor for rehabilitating the Ringim General Hospital, constructing a new specialist hospital and providing free drugs to pregnant women and children. He described the appointment of three commissioners from Ringim, overseeing Special Duties, Agriculture and Power, as an unprecedented political opportunity for the area. Danmalam added that more than 30 other political appointments had been given to indigenes of the local government under the present administration. “I don’t think we have ever enjoyed these kinds of privileges in the history of Ringim Local Government Area. The governor has given us more than we expected,” he said. He urged residents, party members and supporters to demonstrate their appreciation by voting for all APC candidates, from the presidency to the State House of Assembly. Danmalam expressed confidence that Ringim would be among the first local government areas in Jigawa State to deliver substantial votes for the ruling party. “By the grace of God, Ringim will be the first local government to deliver victory for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, Governor Umar Namadi and all other APC candidates in the 2027 general elections,” he said. items.title: 8 India-sponsored terrorists killed in Quetta, Khuzdar, Nushki districts: ISPR
items.description: Security forces have killed eight “India-sponsored” terrorists during three intelligence-based operations conducted in the Quetta, Nushki and Khuzdar districts of Balochistan, Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) said on Sunday. The IBOs took place on Oct 17 (Saturday) on the “reported presence of terrorists belonging to Indian proxy Fitna al Hindustan ”, the military’s media affairs wing said in its press release . The state has designated Balochistan-based groups as Fitna al Hindustan to highlight India’s role in terrorism and destabilisation across Pakistan. In the Panjpai area of Quetta district, terrorists’ attempt to establish a roadblock to disrupt local traffic was “intercepted by security forces, resulting in [the] killing of five India-sponsored terrorists”. Separately, during a sanitisation operation in Nushki district, security forces busted a terrorist hideout and “after an intense fire exchange, two India-sponsored terrorists were sent to hell”. Weapons and ammunition were also recovered, ISPR added. In another IBO in Khuzdar, a terrorist hideout was “engaged by security forces through prompt offensive action”, killing one terrorist. ISPR said a large quantity of explosives (490 kilogrammes) was also recovered. Sanitisation operations were being conducted to eliminate any other terrorist found in the area, according to the statement. ISPR reaffirmed that the “relentless counterterrorism campaign under Vision ‘ Azm-i-Istehkam ’ (as approved by the Federal Apex Committee on the National Action Plan) by security forces and law enforcement agencies of Pakistan will continue at full pace to wipe out the menace of foreign-sponsored and supported terrorism from the country”. President Asif Ali Zardari, in a statement, paid tribute to the security forces for eliminating eight terrorists. He also commended their professional capabilities for thwarting the attempt to disrupt traffic in Quetta, as well as their actions in Nushki and Khuzdar. “Conspiracies of the terrorists’ foreign patrons and their local facilitators will be foiled,” President Zardari declared. Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif also commended the security forces, state-run Associated Press of Pakistan reported. He said the forces were achieving significant successes in the fight against terrorism under the vision of ‘Azm-i-Istehkam’ and reiterated the government’s resolve to completely eradicate all forms of terrorism from the country. In his statement, Balochistan Chief Minister Sarfraz Bugti said operations will continue until terrorism is completely eradicated from the province and peace is established. “There will be no compromise on Pakistan’s integrity, peace, and the protection of its people,” he affirmed. Intensified operations Balochistan has witnessed an increase in terrorist activities in recent years, prompting security forces to intensify counterterrorism operations. On the night of Oct 12/13, security forces busted a terrorist hideout and killed five terrorists during an IBO in Washuk, ISPR said . Days later, Balochistan government officials said that six terrorists affiliated with the banned Tehreek-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), two would-be female suicide bombers, and two commanders of a banned organisation had been arrested during IBOs across the province. They said around 90 arrested terrorists were being held at a centre where investigations and legal proceedings were under way. Earlier this month, five terrorists were eliminated in Balochistan’s Mastung district, state media reported . The number of terrorist attacks in the province increased by seven per cent from 83 in July to 89 in August , according to data compiled by the Pakistan Institute for Conflict and Security Studies (PICSS). As per the report, Balochistan was declared the province “most affected” by terrorism.

items.title: How the Rabbit Revolution Went Too Far
items.description: T his is the moment I knew that the whole vibrator thing had gone too far: It was about a year ago, and I’d ordered a replacement rabbit, the model I’d fallen for around 2007, amid the vibrator renaissance brought about by Sex and the City . An early episode of that zeitgeist show features the prudish Charlotte, having reluctantly bought a “Rabbit Pearl” on the advice of her friend Miranda, becoming so addicted to her new toy that she stops leaving her apartment, thus turning the rabbit into a cultural icon for female pleasure. More than a quarter century had passed since that innocent moment, and the rabbit—once a battery-operated device with a clunky rotating shaft and dainty bunny ears that shivered with astonishing proficiency—had turned sleek and space-age. The rabbits I ordered had USB chargers and a variety of speeds. They had safety locks and silencers, like guns. I didn’t want all these added features—22 speeds was about 20 too many—but I could never remember the name of the most recent one I’d ordered, so I had to Google best rabbit vibrators , a quest that once upon a time had taken me to niche women’s websites but now took me to The New York Times ’ Wirecutter. It’s not that the newer rabbit models don’t work; it’s that they do too much. I mean, I wouldn’t buy a spatula that also dusted the floor. My latest model was so fancy and complicated that it took me a while to figure out how to switch it on, but the real problem was that, once it was on, I could not figure out how to turn the thing off. The day I received it, I was about to record a podcast, a detail that sounds irrelevant until you realize what I was up against: I could not have a vibrator droning on in the background of an hour-long audio conversation. I spent minutes that felt like hours desperately pushing three buttons in alternating sequences only to be thwarted—the rabbit would not turn off. It thumped, it jittered, it whirred round and round. I determined that the only way to shut the damn thing up would be to run down its battery. Racing to beat the clock before the podcast began, I bolted to my front door to place the infernal device outside, where its insistent whirring wouldn’t be picked up by the mic. Just before I got there, I somehow hit the right sequence, and the vibrator finally shut down. What a sad modern portrait: a single woman, living alone, with a rabbit vibrator jackhammering haplessly against her door. Around that time, I happened to be listening to Dax Shepard’s Armchair Expert podcast when I heard a sex therapist say, “Turn down the speed on your vibrators.” Shepard—a modern man in the sex-positive mold—sounded confused; he seemed to be under the impression that vibrators were good for women. Weren’t we all? I ’d been thinking about turning down the speed on my vibrator for a long time, but I’d considered my affliction personal, not society-wide. Now it was dawning on me that the problem wasn’t simply mine. Women are being sold egg-shaped suction devices in the pages of New York magazine, and BookTok influencers pair with sex-toy companies for promotional collabs. Yes, there is a bookmark that doubles as a vibrator. (“Building a world where women choose their pleasure + their power,” reads the Instagram bio for Her Little Bookmark.) Does this consumer game of one-upmanship amid the mainstreaming of vibrators even matter? There are too many varieties of women’s razors, too, and I don’t care. But what worries me is how this points in the direction in which so much of modern life has been barreling: self-pleasure, self-love, self-care, self, self, self. This is where my mind goes when I read or hear a certain type of brittle “Don’t need a man, I have a vibrator” argument, a flex that’s been prevalent on social media for at least a decade. I’d love to see a chart of the well-documented sex recession laid across a chart of vibrator sales. A vibrator may get you off better than a man (or a woman, for that matter), but will it clean the gutters? Hold you in the dark? Kill the rat skittering around the attic? I write these words, and then I think: But wait, what if one day it can? I arrived late to vibrators, or perhaps I should say masturbation, in the relatively vibrator-shy ’90s. I was a few years out of college, sharing pitchers of beer with my buddy Aaron, and we were about halfway through the second pitcher when I shared a very personal detail: I’d never had an orgasm. Not ever? Aaron was fascinated but not judgmental; in fact, another female friend had recently confessed something similar, and he’d researched the problem late one night (he was in law school, and miserable) and discovered that her predicament was both common and easy to solve. “You need the Cadillac of vibrators,” he said, referring to the Hitachi Magic Wand, a personal massager that resembled a large white microphone. The Hitachi, he’d learned, launched women into such paroxysms of pleasure that it had acquired cult status. And he’d heard that you could buy it at Walmart. Walmart? I was incredulous. Walmart had famously eighty-sixed popular albums by Marilyn Manson and (of all people) Sheryl Crow, but Aaron explained that this was part of the ruse. All of those “personal massagers” I’d seen in Sharper Image catalogs? Those were vibrators. Why else were they waterproof? I had to admit that he had a point. [ From the September 2026 issue: The great romance slump ] We drove to Walmart but it didn’t have the Cadillac of vibrators. Unwilling to end our adventure, Aaron picked up an alternate model he declared the “Ford Taurus of vibrators.” The picture on the front resembled a plug-in hand mixer. Whatever, I’d come this far. That night, alone in my garage apartment, I unwrapped the box, drank some red wine to set the mood, and plugged the Ford Taurus of vibrators into an outlet, only to discover that the cord didn’t reach the bed. Was there an extension cord around? Never mind. I lay down nervously on a small braided rug, staring at the slowly rotating blades of the ceiling fan, and turned on the power, only to discover that hell no . It felt like industrial turbines were juddering against my most sensitive spot. Hard pass. But a few nights later, I got an idea. Back in high school, my mother had given me a Brookstone mini-massager she’d bought at the mall, a stocking stuffer for a teen daughter with D cups and upper-back pain. I’d been lugging it from apartment to apartment like a kitchen utensil I never used. It was demure and beige, the size of a small flashlight, and it was waterproof. Huh, never noticed that . Drumming up my courage, I closed the curtains, lit votive candles, uncorked a bottle of wine, and settled under the covers with a device I would eventually know as the “pocket rocket.” And that name fit. I felt like I was being shot into space. T he history of vibrators is a bit murky. In the Next Room (Or The Vibrator Play) is a 2009 Broadway production dramatizing the idea that Victorian doctors used early vibrators on women deemed “hysterical,” a term derived from the Greek word hystera , for “womb,” the supposed origin of women’s madness. Did this happen? I like to think so. Evidence suggests that even the ancient Romans applied this approach to treating female mental illness. The second-century physician Galen wrote of treating a woman whose brain he believed to be dangerously bathed in her unreleased sexual fluids. He applied “manual stimulation,” and ta-da, “she was cured.” (The patient “took great pleasure from this,” Galen noted.) Of course, the technology that transformed society, according to most accounts of women’s liberation and the sexual revolution, was birth control. The pill came out in the ’60s, but in many states only married women could get a prescription. It wasn’t until the ’70s that the pill went mainstream, allowing women to set a course for their own reproduction, a power they’d never had, at least in such potent and efficient form. But the sexual revolution and women’s liberation could also be at odds with each other. On one hand were Our Bodies, Ourselves , consciousness-raising sessions, hand mirrors held between the thighs. On the other hand were the normalization of casual sex without consequence, the “zipless fuck,” the rise of Penthouse and skirt hems—all seeming to serve men’s pleasure more than women’s. Or did they? Helen Gurley Brown and Erica Jong argued otherwise. But then, in 1976, a sex educator named Shere Hite published The Hite Report , possibly the most revealing document ever produced about women’s sexual proclivities (more revealing, I’d say, than the more famous studies from Alfred Kinsey). To read The Hite Report now is to be gobsmacked by the sheer industriousness of women in the pre-vibrator era. Everyday items such as carrots and candles became ersatz phalluses; women sought climax under running bathwater or against the flat, vibrating side of an electric shaver. One woman even made creative use of an ashtray. The raw-liver scene in Philip Roth’s 1969 novel, Portnoy’s Complaint , may be the most famous over-the-top depiction of masturbation in American literature, but The Hite Report may be Portnoy ’s feminine counterpart, with its robust chronicle of women’s sometimes Byzantine pursuit of pleasure. For all The Hite Report ’s descriptions of private erotic delight, though, the book’s strongest running theme is the deep and shameful fear expressed by women who were not getting themselves off, and didn’t know how. “I finally had an orgasm,” a woman tells people at a swanky party in 1979’s Manhattan , “and my doctor told me it was the wrong kind.” By the ’70s and ’80s, bored grocery shoppers could flip through Helen Gurley Brown’s Cosmopolitan to find new blow-job techniques while in the checkout line. But in the 1989 film Parenthood , a family dinner is interrupted by a power outage, and the everyman played by Steve Martin searches for a flashlight only to find his divorced sister’s big dildo buzzing in his hand as the lights flicker back on. She’s mortified. I got the message: As a woman, giving pleasure to your partner was good; seeking pleasure for yourself was embarrassing. As a teen, I had Parenthood and Fast Times on VHS, and I studied them to become a more sophisticated version of myself. Believe it or not, the idea of masturbation never occurred to me. Put my hands down there ? That was my boyfriend’s business. Not long after he and I broke up, he started hanging out with a cool college girl who drew a map of the clitoris. When he told me this over the phone, I was furious and humiliated. And also: Could I borrow that drawing? For women of my generation, messages about sexual pleasure were mixed at best. Dr. Ruth was on the airwaves, adorably chirping about the joys of sexual freedom and toys that could assist women in their quest. But when I was in college, Joycelyn Elders was forced to resign as Bill Clinton’s surgeon general. Her alleged crime? She talked about the benefits of masturbation. S elf-pleasure is the foundation of all human sexuality, the late Betty Dodson used to say. Dodson was a pioneer of sex-positive feminism who taught workshops for women with the same body hang-ups she’d once had. Dodson died in 2020, but her legacy is etched across the early 21st century, in shows such as Girls and stores including Gwyneth Paltrow’s Goop, which infamously sold a jade egg for insertion into the vagina. By the 2010s, sex toys were everywhere. Posters for Grace and Frankie , a Netflix comedy starring 70-something Jane Fonda and Lily Tomlin, featured the silver-haired heroines holding purple vibrating-wand massagers like light sabers. A charming 2016 Netflix series called Love , about dating in Los Angeles, features a scene wherein the beautiful but troubled protagonist tumbles into bed with her suitor only to reach into her bedside drawer, pull out her vibrator, and go to town on herself as he waits, awkwardly, for her to finish. I took the point—self-pleasure could go too far; moderation was the prudent path—but I was about 40 when I saw that Netflix show. I was chronically single and trying to date sober (another story entirely), and I was not ready to slow down the odyssey of delights kicked off by my Brookstone pocket rocket. My bedside drawer was filled with items bought on a whim (a tongue-shaped pink vibe, a pocket rocket shaped like lipstick to sneak past airport security). I collected vibrators from online depots that sent the products in discreet packaging. The idea that vibrators, touted as a way to encourage women’s sexual exploration, might be keeping them from experiences they craved—intimacy, physical touch, actual relationships—was something of a taboo subject in those years. I doubt many sex therapists wanted to be on record telling women to masturbate less when many women didn’t masturbate at all. The arrival of the MeToo movement in 2017 pushed the battle of the sexes closer to a full-scale war; shocking reports about “good guys” such as Charlie Rose and Matt Lauer ( Matt Lauer?! ) left women I knew wondering whether it was simply safest and best to opt out of dating entirely. But I was dismayed to find women on social media braying that they didn’t need a man if they had a vibrator. Because … was it possible that part of the reason I hadn’t found the long-term partner I wanted so badly was that I had too many vibrators? I’m not saying vibrators kept me from dating. I dated a ton. I’m saying that when the dating market proved challenging and the men not quite right, it was all too easy to return to my empty house at the end of a less than stellar evening, pluck out a buzzing rocket ship from my nightstand drawer, and find release. [ Read: Are we in an intimacy crisis? ] I think it was 2022, late in the pandemic era, when I started wondering whether that drawer, so clogged with toys that it was becoming hard to shut, had turned into a paltry substitute for the beauty I had assumed life would deliver, to love and be loved by another. I noticed that sex with a man I cared about left me feeling saturated and soul-satisfied, whereas getting off with a mechanical device left me sleepy and only lightly relieved, like I’d managed to scratch a stubborn itch. I dated a man who stroked the pale skin of my inner elbow in the most electric way, and when he was gone, I tried replicating this in my bed, but it never worked. I needed the surprise of his touch. I have spent most of my adulthood alone, at least from a relationship standpoint, and it’s not a bad way to be, but therapists and dating experts will tell you it’s only in relationship to others that we truly know ourselves. “You’re too picky.” I’ve heard it a million times, and I’m guilty as charged. I wouldn’t have it any other way. I’ve fought too hard for this odd, beautiful life to share it with a man who doesn’t fit. And yet I know from my closest friendships and creative partnerships that living side by side requires work. Conflict, civil disagreements, crossed wires that leave me feeling rattled and badly misunderstood—that’s how I learn. That’s how I grow. I worry that technology-induced orgasms on demand made it too easy for me—and made it too easy for society at large—to stay cocooned in a little pod of self-gratification: Netflix, DoorDash, Amazon Prime, conversations that weren’t real conversations, mediated through the flat screens of text and social media. It feels good in the instant, and it can feel awfully empty as the years pass. If you keep scratching that stubborn itch, do you ever address the reason you’re itching in the first place? When Gloria Steinem died last month, I thought about the line she made famous in the ’70s heyday of second-wave feminism: “A woman needs a man like a fish needs a bicycle.” Was it a joke? A slogan more than a commandment? In 2000, Steinem married the entrepreneur David Bale, and after he died, she was grief-stricken. I doubt that line, clever and quotable, was ever meant to be taken literally, but the glib notion that women don’t need romantic love remains one of the most pernicious strains of the female-empowerment age. I am now 52. I’ve never been married, and I’ve never had kids, and although I’ve come to terms with that , I wonder how the combination of certain early-21st-century ideas about women’s independence and certain vibrator technologies shaped the trajectory of my romantic life. I don’t plan to give up masturbation, or vibrators, though I’ve tossed several, including the jackhammering rabbit of doorstep-thumping fame. A technological assist can be helpful—and fun—but when it becomes a crutch, or even a solitary delivery system, maybe it’s time to rethink how we’ve valorized the vibrator, or at least the notion of vibrators everywhere all the time, every day of the week. I’ve started to see vibrators as proto–sex robots that have been Trojan horsed into the culture under the guise of female pleasure only to acquire Bluetooth capabilities and talismanic status among the women who swear by them. How long before these things start talking with us? Answering our emails? Doing our taxes? We live in a convenience culture whose engine runs on the tantalizing promise that we can skip the hard parts—the cooking, the cleaning, the infinite search for a better half—but I have learned that the hard part is also, in many instances, the best part. Pushing past those frustrating challenges into discovery can be a source of such pleasure. The great lie of modern culture is that we don’t need one another. Maybe not all women need men, but I’ve come to realize that this one does. Of course, men need women too. Men need men, and women need women, and so on. The salesmen of the 21st century will keep slinging their wares: DIY! AI companion! Chatbot boyfriend! Like so much of our day-to-day lives, getting off is becoming more efficient, easier, faster. But has it gotten better?

items.title: Tensions over headscarves, Israel test Azerbaijan-Turkiye ties
items.description: The normally close ties between Turkiye and Azerbaijan have come under strain, fuelled by a dispute over Baku’s restrictions on headscarves in schools and disagreements over Israel. Public tensions have become evident in what has traditionally been a very close relationship between two nations which share a common language and whose bond is characterised by the slogan: One nation, two states. Although the rhetoric has remained restrained at the top, senior officials have been more outspoken in their reactions. On Monday, Oktay Saral, chief adviser to President Recep Tayyip Erdogan, shed his normal diplomatic reserve to denounce as “unacceptable” Azerbaijan’s move to change school uniform regulations , banning anything that conflicts with the normal uniform or the secular principles of education. “The headscarf is not an obstacle; it is a requirement of faith! The right to education cannot be sacrificed to any ideological imposition!” he wrote on X. “We expect Azerbaijan to reverse this mistake as soon as possible.” The following day, the ruling Yeni Azerbaijan Party (YAP) hit back with a sharply worded statement denouncing Saral and MPs from Erdogan’s AKP for their “populist and irresponsible statements”. “The recent disinformation campaign targeting Azerbaijan has become increasingly aggressive, systematic, and openly slanderous,” it said. The confrontation reflected sharp differences between Azerbaijan — one of the most secular states in the Muslim world — and the leadership in Ankara. But it also highlighted tensions over the growing rapprochement between Azerbaijan and Israel since Baku’s 2020 Karabakh war with arch-foe Armenia, when the Israelis supplied them with drones and other weaponry. Turkiye’s ties with Israel, by contrast, could hardly be worse, with Erdogan accusing Israel of genocide in Gaza and Ankara regularly releasing images of top-level talks with the leaders of Hamas, whose October 2023 attacks on Israel sparked the latter’s onslaught on Gaza. Baku more ‘pragmatic’ Turkiye’s pro-government media has held little back, with the Yeni Safak daily denouncing the headscarf regulations as a gesture towards Israel. “We firmly reject attempts to deliberately distort Azerbaijani-Israeli relations, portray these ties as supposedly exceptional, and use this as a basis for making political accusations against Azerbaijan,” the country’s ruling party said. The sharp response underscores Azerbaijan’s emergence as a regional middle power. It is more willing to push back against Turkiye as Ankara seeks to project influence from the Black Sea, increasingly ensnared by the Russia-Ukraine war, and an ever-more volatile Middle East. “The changing geopolitical order in the greater Eurasia has enabled Azerbaijan to pursue a more pragmatic foreign policy,” said Fuad Shahbazov, an independent political analyst, indicating that meant Baku now “categorically resists the attempts of external actors, even its ally Turkiye”. But on Friday, Kursad Zorlu, deputy head of Erdogan’s AKP, said the two sides knew how to tackle problems “within the family” in what appeared to be a tacit call for online restraint. At a regional summit in Baku on Thursday, Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan hailed “the unshakable bond … between our leaders” despite being tested “in very difficult times”. Too much to lose Observers agree the two nations share too much to risk a rupture. “The sometimes-tense relations with Moscow and the Iran war happening next door mean that Baku cannot afford to alienate an otherwise good partner,” Ivan Klyszcz of the Estonia-based International Centre for Defence and Security (ICDS) told AFP . “Moreover, energy cooperation, ongoing well before the current spat, is too important for both parties,” he stressed. “For Turkiye, Azerbaijan is an essential gate for Central Asia, a region … seen by Ankara as strategic.” Paradoxically, Baku seems to hold the cards, despite the fact that its population is ten times smaller than that of its ally. “The litmus test of the Baku-Ankara axis will depend on the latter’s further attitude and commitment to quickly get back on diplomatic tracks to handle this crisis,” Shahbazov told AFP . “Azerbaijan possesses energy leverage and access to the Central Asian region, giving it leverage over Turkiye,” he said. And this is a crucial asset, given Ankara’s ambition to maintain its role as a transit hub between Europe and Asia. Even so, points of friction remain. On Friday, Baku said it had issued an “international arrest warrant” for a Turkish journalist working for the Sanliurfa Olay daily. According to prosecutors, Celal Ciftci called for a “coup d’tat” in Azerbaijan and promoted “religious extremism”.

items.title: Italie : des manifestations contre la vie chère dégénèrent en violents affrontements à Milan
items.description: De violents affrontements ont eclate le 17 octobre dans le centre de Milan, lors d'une manifestation contre la hausse du coût de la vie et la politique du gouvernement italien. Plus de 5 000 personnes ont participe au rassemblement, selon les estimations policieres. Initialement pacifique, le cortege a ete marque par des violences lorsque des groupes de jeunes manifestants, dont certains masques, ont lance des pierres, des bouteilles et des petards sur les forces de l'ordre. Les heurts se sont concentres autour de la place du Duomo et de la galerie Vittorio Emanuele II. Plusieurs commerces ont ete vandalises, du mobilier urbain endommage et des toilettes mobiles incendiees pres de la cathedrale. La police a deploye des gaz lacrymogenes et des canons a eau pour disperser les groupes impliques dans les affrontements. Des stations de metro ont ete fermees, tandis que touristes et passants quittaient le secteur. BREAKING: Massive riots have now also broken out in Milan, Italy. An alliance of migrant gangs and Antifa extremists is attacking police officers and setting fires in front of the Milan Cathedral (Duomo) https://t.co/yh8sbPWmsS — Visegrád 24 (@visegrad24) October 17, 2026 Total chaos outside the symbol of Christianity in Milan, the Cathedral. Paper bombs, firecrackers, cars destroyed, attacks on police, insults and shouting right in front of the Duomo. No Italian, not even the worst, would dare to light fires and shoot fireworks against the Duomo. An insult that cannot be explained and forgotten. — RadioGenoa (@RadioGenoa) October 17, 2026 Au total, 25 personnes ont ete blessees, dont dix membres des forces de l'ordre. Aucun blesse n'a ete signale dans un etat critique. Les bilans disponibles font etat de 50 a 60 interpellations a Milan, dont de nombreux mineurs. La contestation a egalement ete marquee par des affrontements avec la police a Turin et a Bologne, ou douze et sept personnes ont respectivement ete interpellees. Pouvoir d'achat et depenses militaires au cœur du mecontentement Ces evenements surviennent dans un contexte de mobilisation sociale contre les orientations du gouvernement de Giorgia Meloni. Des le 16 octobre, des manifestations ont ete organisees a Rome, Milan, Turin, Bologne et Naples, a l'appel de syndicats etudiants et de mouvements de jeunesse de gauche. Les premiers rassemblements ont ete baptises « Journee sans Meloni ». Au-dela de la hausse des prix, les manifestants denoncent le coût du carburant et la pression fiscale qui pesent sur les revenus des menages. Ils reclament des salaires plus eleves et davantage de moyens pour l'education, la sante et les services publics. Les choix budgetaires du gouvernement sont egalement contestes. Certains participants denoncent les coûts lies a la fameuse « economie de guerre » et reclament une reduction des depenses militaires au profit des besoins sociaux. Ces revendications traduisent notamment les inquietudes exprimees face au pouvoir d'achat et au financement des services publics. Meloni condamne les violences, la mobilisation sociale se poursuit La Premiere ministre Giorgia Meloni a condamne les affrontements et demande a l'opposition de denoncer les violences. « Manifester est un droit. Transformer nos villes en champs de bataille ne l'est pas », a-t-elle declare sur X le 17 octobre. a Rome, une importante manifestation organisee par la Confederation generale italienne du travail (CGIL) a reuni etudiants, salaries et retraites autour de revendications economiques et sociales. Son secretaire general, Maurizio Landini, a annonce une greve generale pour le 20 novembre afin de reclamer une hausse des salaires, une meilleure protection sociale et davantage de financements pour les services publics. Cette vague de protestations intervient parallelement aux manifestations contre la vie chere en France, egalement marquees par des affrontements avec les forces de l'ordre. En Italie, les prochaines mobilisations sont deja annoncees, avec un rassemblement prevu a Rome le 30 octobre, avant la greve generale du 20 novembre.

items.title: Several dead or injured in major fire at Canada military base
items.description: Several people have been killed or injured as a result of a large fire near a Canadian military base in Alberta, the nation’s defence minister has said. David McGuinty did not confirm the cause or the number of casualties, describing the situation as “very, very active and delicate”. The Canadian military and local authorities were managing the fire, he said. Canadian Forces Base Wainwright, where the fire broke out, is one of the country’s busiest military training bases. Canadian TV network Global News reported that at least seven were killed and dozens more injured when a gas line or gas well was hit during a live-fire training exercise, citing unnamed military sources. Canada’s Prime Minister Mark Carney said that a “serious incident creating a major fire” had occurred, adding that his “thoughts are with all the brave women and men affected”. The Canadian Broadcasting Corporation (CBC) said Royal Alexandra Hospital in Edmonton had declared a code orange, a disaster response protocol for responding to a high-casualty incident. Warren Thirsk, an emergency department doctor there, told the broadcaster that the number of patients would otherwise “overwhelm” Edmonton’s healthcare facilities. “It is more patients than any of us want to count right now. It’s a disaster. It’s a one in every 15 to 25-year disaster.” After the fire erupted on Saturday, it “spread rapidly due to high winds” and tore through the fences of the base, the Municipal District of Wainwright said. The region experienced gusts of up to 100km/h (62mph), though local officials indicated fire crews had contained the blaze. The defence minister told reporters he “cannot recall an incident like this in recent memory”. It is unclear when the fire broke out, but the district first posted about the incident at about 17:30 local time (23:30 GMT). Local authorities have urged residents to avoid the area and give all emergency vehicles right of way. The mayor of the nearby town of Wainwright, Bruce Pugh, said it was a “heavy day” for his community. “We have neighbours who are either serving or former members of the Canadian Armed Forces. We’re integrated, our kids play in the same hockey teams, attend the same schools,” he told CBC. While details on the impact of the fire remain unclear, Pugh said he believed this would come to be the area’s largest-ever mass casualty event. Alberta’s Premier Danielle Smith said the “significant and tragic fire” was “affecting many of [the province’s] brave military personnel”. Neighbouring provinces have mobilised in support. Saskatchewan Premier Scott Moe said he had deployed resources to Alberta and was “ready to provide more if required”, while British Columbia Premier David Eby said his government had offered “all possible assistance”. Wainwright is the main base used by the Canadian military for live-fire training exercises, according to CBC, with about 690 military personnel and 300 civilian workers on-site on a typical day.

items.title: Priest dies after statue of Jesus falls on him during mass livestream

The Archdiocese of Guayaquil on Sunday confirmed that Father Molinari had died in a post on social media which said: “We announce that our beloved Fr. items.title: L’épidémie d’Ebola s’étend à la province du Nord-Ubangi de la RDC et au Kenya
items.description: L'epidemie d'Ebola s'est etendue a une huitieme province de la Republique democratique du Congo, selon ce qu'a annonce l'Institut national de sante publique ce 18 octobre. Jusqu'ici, des sources medicales avaient indique deux cas d'infection dans la province du Nord-Ubangi, frontaliere de la Republique centrafricaine, mais le gouvernement n'avait pas officiellement reconnu l'existence des nouveaux cas. Avec ces deux nouveaux cas d'infection, dont un deces, le Nord-Ubangi rejoint les sept autres provinces affectees par l'epidemie, a savoir le Nord-Kivu, l'Ituri, le Haut-Uele, la Tshopo, le Sud-Kivu, le Bas-Uele et le Sud-Ubangi. Le Kenya en alerte maximale avec sept cas d'Ebola D'apres le directeur general de la sante au Kenya, Patrick Amoth, trois nouveaux cas d'infection a l'Ebola ont ete constates chez des membres du personnel de sante, âges de 29, 35 et 32 ans, qui etaient en charge des quatre patients atteints de la maladie pendant leur hospitalisation, entre le 3 et le 4 octobre, avant leur mise en quarantaine le 9 octobre. Selon le ministere kenyan de la Sante, quatre patients presentaient des fievres comme premier symptome avant leur mise immediate en isolement et prelevement d'echantillons pour analyse. Ils etaient testes positifs au virus Bundibugyo, selon le Laboratoire national de reference en virologie et le laboratoire de l'Institut de recherche medicale du Kenya. Pour l'heure, les deuxieme et troisieme patients sont stables et repondaient bien au traitement de soutien, indique le ministere qui a precise que des mises a jour sur l'evolution de la situation concernant tous les cas signales seraient fournies au fur et a mesure de son evolution. Les autorites kenyanes ont aussi indique que 130 contacts, dont 128, soit 98,5 %, avaient ete identifies, retrouves et places en quarantaine. « Le ministere tient a rassurer les Kenyans : le risque pour la population generale reste faible, car il n'existe aucune preuve de transmission communautaire de la maladie », a-t-il indique. Bilan de l'epidemie Jusqu'au 16 octobre, date du dernier rapport de la situation etabli par les autorites sanitaires congolaises, 67 nouveaux cas et 26 deces durant les dernieres 24 heures dans le pays ont porte le bilan a 9 415 cas d'infection confirmee et 4 536 deces, depuis le debut de l'epidemie d'Ebola en mai dernier. Le taux de letalite du virus s'etablit a 48,2 %. La province d'Ituri demeure toujours l'epicentre de l'epidemie avec 44 infections du total enregistre dans les dernieres 24 heures.

items.title: Le Mouvement And Défar a offert 188 poches de sang à l’hôpital Mame Abdou Aziz Sy Dabakh
items.description: 188 poches de sang ont été collectées, ce samedi 17 Octobre 2026, à Tivaouane, lors d’une journée de don de sang, organisée chez Abdoulaye Ndiaye Ngalgou, responsable politique local, à l’initiative du mouvement And Defar Tivaouane. L’activité, qui s’inscrit dans le cadre d’Octobre Rose, mois de sensibilisation à la lutte contre le cancer du sein et du col de l’utérus, a mobilisé les populations et le personnel de l’hôpital Mame Abdou Aziz Sy Dabakh de Tivaouane. Selon le Dr. Mamadou Fall, responsable du laboratoire de l’hôpital, cette mobilisation est salutaire puisqu’elle est intervenue dans un contexte de pénurie récurrente de Sang. En effet, après la période du gamou, la banque de sang de l'hôpital Mame Abdou Aziz Sy Dabakh de Tivaouane fait souvent face à des pénuries inquiétantes, selon le Dr. Fall, responsable de la banque de sang de l'hôpital Mame Abdou Aziz Sy Dabakh de Tivaouane. Grace a une forte mobilisation de ses membres et sympathisants, le mouvement and Défar Tivaouane a offert 188 poches de sang à l'hôpital Mame Abdou Aziz Sy Dabakh. Ce qui constitut un grand ouf de soulagement pour la structure de sante de niveau 2. Selon Dr. Modou Fall, responsable du laboratoire et de la banque de sang, ce don de 188 poches a battu tous les records par rapport aux journées de don de sang, initiées par les populations en faveur de la banque de sang de l'hôpital. Le directeur de l’hôpital, le Dr. Yoro Diagne, a salué cette performance meme si dans d’autres localités comme Thiès, il arrive que des donneurs atteignent la barre de 200 poches. Selon lui, depuis qu’il est à la tête de l’hôpital, en 2024, c’est la première fois qu’une journée de don de sang atteigne la barre de 188 poches à l’hôpital Mame Abdou Aziz Sy Dabakh. « La prise en charge du cancer passe impérativement par la disponibilité du sang. Il n’y a pas de prise en charge sans transfusion « , a rappelé le Dr. Mamadou Ndiaye, invitant les organisations à pérenniser de telles initiatives. Prenant la parole, le responsable politique Abdoulaye Ndiaye Ngalgou a rendu hommage aux femmes de Tivaouane : « Octobre Rose, ce n’est pas seulement une couleur, c’est le cri de cœur nos femmes. Le cancer du sein n’est pas une malédiction. Détecté tôt, il se guérit ». Il a annoncé, dans le cadre de son engagement une fois maire, l’organisation d’une journée de dépistage gratuit chaque mois d’octobre pour 500 femmes de Tivaouane, en collaboration avec des sage-femmes, ainsi qu’une subvention pour le transport des femmes malades devant se rendre à Dakar pour leur chimiothérapie. Pour lui, aucune femme ne devra plus arrêter de se soigner par qu’elle n’a pas le prix du transport. « Aujourd’hui, nous ne donnons pas notre sang, nous donnons la vie. Le sang n’est pas à la pharmacie, il est dans nos veines », a-t-il lancé, citant le verset coranique selon lequel sauver une vie, c’est sauver l’humanité entière. Ibrahima NDIAYE Correspondant

items.title: Gov’t will not lower certification standards under One Million Coders Programme – Sam George
items.description: The Minister for Communication, Digital Technology and Innovation, Samuel Nartey George, says that the government will maintain international certification standards under the One Million Coders Programme (OMCP), even if the requirements make the training more demanding for beneficiaries. He explained that lowering the standards could undermine the international recognition of certificates earned by trainees and jeopardise remote employment opportunities being secured for graduates. Mr George made the remarks during an interaction with trainees as part of a monitoring tour of OMCP learning centres and rural telephony projects in the Volta Region. He was responding to concerns from a beneficiary training to become a cybersecurity expert, who said the course was too demanding. The Minister insisted that maintaining internationally recognised certification benchmarks was in the best interest of trainees, as the government sought to prepare them for opportunities beyond Ghana. He disclosed that the government was engaging Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) companies to create internship and remote employment opportunities for programme graduates. Among the companies involved is a Kenyan firm seeking to establish a centre in Ghana with plans to employ 5,000 people, he said. According to Mr George, the courses offered under the OMCP were deliberately selected to meet the skills requirements of such companies. He urged beneficiaries to progress beyond the beginner level to advanced training, noting that the job market increasingly required higher-level competencies. The Minister added that the training modules were self-paced and free, allowing participants to continue their studies outside the learning centres using their login credentials. He also encouraged trainees with general academic backgrounds to complete the specialised information and communications technology (ICT) versions of their courses to improve their readiness for the job market. As part of the tour, the Minister presented 200 Lenovo laptops to the University of Health and Allied Sciences (UHAS) in Ho under the programme. The laptops feature Intel Core i5 processors, 16GB of RAM, 512GB solid-state drive storage and Windows 11 operating systems. Mr George said the donation was intended to equip future healthcare professionals with digital skills to complement their clinical training as the university expanded technology-based learning. “The medical field is changing very fast. Telemedicine is a big part of the world today, where you have doctors sitting in John Hopkins and carrying out surgery 7,000 miles across the ocean using robotic arms,” he said. He stressed the importance of combining clinical expertise with technological knowledge to keep pace with advances in medical practice. Vice-Chancellor of UHAS, Professor Lydia Aziato, expressed gratitude for the support, saying the selected OMCP learning pathways would complement the university’s professional health sciences training. She added that the courses would help students develop skills in digital literacy, data analytics and emerging technologies.
